subject: Pocket itineraries, smart-tags, and concierge handover for exec workshop — rooming master
messages:
From: Aurelia Hotels <ops@aureliahotels.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exec workshop — room block questions + pocket itineraries

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks for sending the expected headcount for the Dec workshop. A few quick notes from the hotel ops side as we finalize the master rooming: 

1) Smart-tags on keycards: we can program up to three single-character "smart-tags" attached to each key (e.g., A=allergy, D=dietary, W=wheelchair). Before we apply any flags to physical keys, can you confirm whether Redwood prefers us to: (a) encode dietary/allergy info visible to concierge only, (b) use non-descriptive codes (e.g., 1,2,3) so front-desk sees only a code key, or (c) ship a pocket itinerary that lists preferences and flagging separately?

2) Pocket itineraries: we can generate pocket PDFs for each guest and tuck them into arrival packets; we have a template but would prefer your branding and a per-attendee one-line role (e.g., "Redwood — Product Lead"). Please confirm the fields you want (name, role, arrival window, shuttle time, dietary flags, room number placeholder).

3) Concierge handover: we recommend a 30-minute concierge briefing the morning of check-in with your on-site lead. Who will be the on-site Redwood point of contact?

I attached the rooming CSV template and a sample pocket itinerary PDF. If you want us to pre-print smart-tag stickers for the concierge, we'll need the final manifest by EOD Dec 3.

Best,
Aurelia Ops (front-desk & groups)
Aurelia Hotels

Attachments: Aurelia_Master_Rooming_20261130_template.csv, pocket_itinerary_sample.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Aurelia Hotels <ops@aureliahotels.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — room block questions + pocket itineraries

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. A few quick decisions from our side so you can proceed: 

- Smart-tags: option (b) — use non-descriptive numeric codes (1,2,3). We'll provide a secure key mapping to your concierge only. The mapping data should not be printed on guest material.
- Pocket itineraries: yes, please generate one per attendee. Required fields: Full name, company (Redwood Inference), role/title, confirmed arrival window, airport transfer time, dietary flags (coded), accessibility needs (coded), and emergency contact. Room number can remain a placeholder until check-in.
- On-site lead: Marissa Cole will be Redwood's on-site lead and will do the concierge handover at 10:00 AM on Dec 7. Marissa's phone: +1 (415) 555-0123.

Marissa / Laura — can you confirm you can deliver the final attendee list + any special requests by EOD Dec 3? Also: do we want the pocket PDFs branded with Redwood header only, or include a one-page local area map?

Thanks,
Logan
Director, Events & Ops
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 09:12 AM Aurelia Hotels <ops@aureliahotels.com> wrote:

> 
> Thanks for sending the expected headcount for the Dec workshop. A few quick notes...

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: pocket itineraries + smart-tag mapping (action items)

Marissa / Laura — following Aurelia's note, here's the plan and who owns each piece. Please keep replies short (status updates only).

1) Final attendee list (deliverable: CSV with name, preferred name, title, email, flight arrival time, dietary flag code, accessibility flag code) — Owner: Marissa — Due: EOD Dec 3
2) Smart-tag mapping (deliverable: secure doc with code->meaning) — Owner: Laura — Due: EOD Dec 3. Laura, please store the mapping in the shared Vault/Drive link below and do not send as inline email.
3) Pocket itinerary branding & map (deliverable: packaged PDFs per attendee) — Owner: Logan (I'll work with Aurelia once list is final) — Target: Dec 5 morning so hotel can print.
4) Concierge runbook (deliverable: 1-page handoff checklist for the hotel concierge) — Owner: Marissa — Due: Dec 5 morning. Include arrival packet order and escalations for late arrivals.

Suggested smart-tag taxonomy (proposed): 1 = dietary (see mapping), 2 = accessibility (wheelchair/hearing), 3 = VIP (do not disturb requests). We can add a 4 = late-checkin. Keep the codes minimal.

Marissa: can you confirm whether any attendees require early check-in or late checkout? I’ll assemble a single sheet to send to Aurelia.

Drive: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2bRoomingMasterSheet
Vault: https://vault.redwood.com/secrets/smarttags-rooming

Thanks — L

From: Aurelia Hotels <ops@aureliahotels.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@clientcorp.com>, Evergreen Travel <ops@evergreentravel.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — room block questions + pocket itineraries

Logan / Marissa / Laura,

Thanks — received the plan and the Drive link. Attached is our filled master rooming CSV (Aurelia_Master_Rooming_20261205.csv) and the pocket itinerary template (pocket_itinerary_template.pdf). Highlights: 

- We applied non-descriptive numeric codes to the concierge system per your preference. We'll only share the mapping with your on-site lead (Marissa) during the concierge handover on Dec 7.
- Pocket itineraries will be printed and placed in arrival packets; we included a one-page neighborhood map at the bottom of each PDF. If you prefer to remove the map, let us know within 24 hours.
- A few attendees flagged for early check-in (see row 18, 21 in the CSV). We will attempt to have those rooms ready; please confirm if any overrides are needed for VIPs.

DocuSign: We routed the master direct bill agreement to Evan Brooks at ClientCorp (link below). Please advise if Redwood will be on the master bill or if ClientCorp covers conference rooms only.
